spesialisasi_singkat: Actuary, Underwriting, and Data Analytics Enthusiast
deskripsi: I am an Actuarial Science graduate with a strong interest in Actuarial, Underwriting, and Data Analytics. With hands-on experience in the insurance industry, I have developed an understanding of insurance operations, claims, documentation, and data analysis. I enjoy working with numbers and data, solving problems, and exploring how analytical approaches can support better decisions. I am a curious, detail-oriented, and adaptable person who is always eager to learn, take on new challenges, and grow both professionally and personally.
